environment.description: Kubernetes deployment with Pod Security Admission enforcing 'restricted' profile. Container securityContext drops ALL capabilities then adds only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Additionally, the pod spec includes a seccomp profile of type RuntimeDefault and an AppArmor annotation (container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/app=runtime/default). The container runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true (uid 65534), and an emptyDir volume mounted at /tmp. The node uses a gVisor (runsc) runtime class which intercepts all syscalls through its application kernel, preventing direct host filesystem access even if the application attempts file:// URI resolution. The gVisor sentry does not implement the openat2 syscall variant used by the Go runtime's os.ReadFile on newer kernels, causing ENOSYS for any file read operations targeting paths outside the OCI bundle's rootfs layer.

config.runtime_details: gVisor runsc with restricted platform (ptrace), host filesystem isolated via overlay with no bind mounts to sensitive paths
